descriptions: 9 healthy subjects received an oral dose of Cilazapril 5 mg or HCTZ 25 mg or a combination of both, 16 patients with hypertension received 2.5 mg cilazapril, 25 mg HCT or the combination 2.5 + 25 mg of the respective drugs once daily for 2 weeks in a randomized double-blind two way crossover study
